blocks.zh: 積木式標籤設計：從 SSCC 基礎到 DSCSA 序列化擴展 | p37–p43
blocks.en: Building Block Label Design: From SSCC Foundation to DSCSA Serialization Extension | p37–p43

blocks.zh: C.1–C.2 標籤定義與積木概念
blocks.en: C.1–C.2 Label Definition and the Building Block Concept

blocks.zh: Label（標籤）指套用在包裝上的印刷區域，包含文字與／或條碼資料（線性條碼、複合式或 2D 符號）。可分開印製並在不同階段黏貼，組合成完整標籤。
blocks.en: Label means a printed area applied to a package that carries text and/or bar code data (linear, composite or 2D symbols). It can be printed separately and applied at different stages to assemble a complete label.

blocks.zh: 積木式結構（building block）是標籤格式的基本標準單元，每個積木或子積木可包含：
blocks.en: A building block is the basic standard unit of a label format. Each block or sub-block may contain:

blocks.zh: 文字或圖形
blocks.en: Text or graphics

blocks.zh: 條碼符號（2D 或線性，含人可讀詮釋）
blocks.en: Bar code symbols (2D or linear, with human readable interpretation)

blocks.zh: 空白區
blocks.en: Blank space

blocks.zh: 積木可個別製作或與其他積木結合，支援「資料產生後即印製」的彈性流程。積木應以垂直堆疊方式排列。
blocks.en: Blocks can be produced individually or combined with other blocks, supporting a flexible "print when the data becomes available" workflow. Blocks should be arranged by vertical stacking.

blocks.zh: C.3–C.4 LPB 文字高度 & 區段
blocks.en: C.3–C.4 LPB Text Height & Segments

blocks.zh: 文字高度以 Lines-Per-Block (LPB) 定義，共 9 種（1–8 及 10 LPB），由標籤印製商依設備能力選定實際字高。標準定義三個資訊區段（segment），由上而下堆疊：
blocks.en: Text height is defined in Lines-Per-Block (LPB), with 9 sizes (1–8 and 10 LPB); the label printer selects the actual character height according to equipment capability. The standard defines three information segments, stacked from top to bottom:

blocks.zh: Carrier segment（承運人區段）— 置頂
blocks.en: Carrier segment — at the top

blocks.zh: Consignee segment（收貨人區段）
blocks.en: Consignee segment

blocks.zh: Shipper segment（發貨人區段）— 置底
blocks.en: Shipper segment — at the bottom

blocks.zh: C.5–C.6 標籤尺寸與格式規範
blocks.en: C.5–C.6 Label Size and Format Requirements

blocks.zh: 標籤尺寸不固定，由標籤印製商依貿易夥伴需求、設備能力及運輸包裝大小決定。
blocks.en: Label size is not fixed; it is determined by the label printer according to trading partner needs, equipment capability and the size of the shipping package.

blocks.zh: 積木尺寸規範（Table C.1 摘要）
blocks.en: Block dimension requirements (summary of Table C.1)

blocks.zh: 每個積木最多可分為 4 個子積木（sub-block），以垂直分隔線區分。文字積木／子積木不得包含條碼符號；條碼應置於獨立的條碼符號積木中。
blocks.en: Each block can be divided into up to 4 sub-blocks, separated by vertical dividing lines. A text block or sub-block must not contain a bar code symbol; bar codes should be placed in a separate bar code symbol block.

blocks.zh: * 字高含 ascenders、descenders 及 leading。字高寬比不超過 2:1（以「M」字元量測）。
blocks.en: * Character height includes ascenders, descenders and leading. The height-to-width ratio must not exceed 2:1 (measured on the character "M").

blocks.zh: 積木式設計與 Pharma CDMO 應用解析
blocks.en: Building Block Design and Its Application in Pharma CDMOs

blocks.zh: 比喻：積木式標籤 = 樂高積木
blocks.en: Analogy: building block label = LEGO bricks

blocks.zh: 想像一張出貨標籤是由不同顏色的樂高積木垂直疊起：最頂層是給快遞掃描用的 SSCC 積木，中間是給客戶用的 GTIN + Lot + Expiry 積木，最底層是發貨人資訊積木。每層可獨立印製、替換，不影響其他層。
blocks.en: Imagine a shipping label as LEGO bricks of different colors stacked vertically: the top layer is the SSCC block for courier scanning, the middle is the GTIN + Lot + Expiry block for the customer, and the bottom layer is the shipper information block. Each layer can be printed and replaced independently without affecting the others.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 特別實用：序列號（serial number）通常在最後包裝工序才確定，用積木設計就能在前段先貼 GTIN/Lot 積木，最後再貼上序列號積木，完成 DSCSA 合規標籤。
blocks.en: This is especially useful for a CDMO: the serial number is usually only determined at the final packaging step, so with a building block design the GTIN/Lot block can be applied early and the serial number block added last to complete a DSCSA-compliant label.

blocks.zh: LPB 選用原則 — CDMO 實務
blocks.en: LPB Selection Principles — CDMO Practice

blocks.zh: 標題文字（Title）：固定 6 LPB，大寫，左對齊，最多 2 行
blocks.en: Title text: fixed at 6 LPB, uppercase, left aligned, maximum 2 lines

blocks.zh: 主要資料（如 Lot No.、Exp Date）：建議 3–4 LPB
blocks.en: Primary data (e.g., Lot No., Exp Date): 3–4 LPB recommended

blocks.zh: 次要資料（如 PO#、重量）：5–6 LPB
blocks.en: Secondary data (e.g., PO#, weight): 5–6 LPB

blocks.zh: 條碼 HRI（人可讀詮釋）：通常 5–7 LPB，置於條碼下方
blocks.en: Bar code HRI (human readable interpretation): typically 5–7 LPB, placed below the bar code

blocks.zh: 同一標籤上各 LPB 尺寸需有明顯視覺差異；8 LPB 必須明顯小於 7 LPB。
blocks.en: The LPB sizes used on the same label must be visibly different; 8 LPB must be clearly smaller than 7 LPB.

blocks.zh: Pharma 積木建構順序：SSCC → GTIN → Serial
blocks.en: Pharma Building Block Sequence: SSCC → GTIN → Serial

blocks.zh: Step 1 — 製造 / 包裝階段
blocks.en: Step 1 — Manufacturing / Packaging Stage

blocks.zh: GTIN (AI 01) + Lot (AI 10) + Exp (AI 17) → 條碼積木 #1
blocks.en: GTIN (AI 01) + Lot (AI 10) + Exp (AI 17) → bar code block #1

blocks.zh: Step 2 — 出貨準備
blocks.en: Step 2 — Shipment Preparation

blocks.zh: + SSCC (AI 00) → Carrier 積木 (置頂)
blocks.en: + SSCC (AI 00) → Carrier block (at top)

blocks.zh: Step 3 — DSCSA / EU FMD 序列化
blocks.en: Step 3 — DSCSA / EU FMD Serialization

blocks.zh: + Serial No. (AI 21) + NCC (AI 422) → 序列積木貼覆
blocks.en: + Serial No. (AI 21) + NCC (AI 422) → serial block applied over

blocks.zh: 重點：多階段貼標的合規風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Compliance Risk of Multi-Stage Labelling

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 允許「分段貼標」，但 GMP 要求每次更動均需書面紀錄。CDMO 必須在 BPR（批次記錄）中明確記錄各積木印製時間點、操作人員及核驗結果，以符合 21 CFR Part 211.68 及 EU GMP Annex 15 要求。
blocks.en: ISO 15394 allows "staged labelling", but GMP requires every change to be documented. A CDMO must clearly record in the BPR (batch production record) the time each block was printed, the operator and the verification result, to meet 21 CFR Part 211.68 and EU GMP Annex 15.

blocks.zh: 制定符合本標準的產業應用指引：需考量的要素清單 | p41–p43
blocks.en: Developing an Industry Application Guideline Consistent with This Standard: Checklist of Elements | p41–p43

blocks.zh: D.1 總則
blocks.en: D.1 General

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 是框架標準，各產業的具體應用指引（application guideline）應在遵循本標準的前提下進一步細化。Annex D 列出 12 項產業指引需定義的要素。
blocks.en: ISO 15394 is a framework standard; industry-specific application guidelines should refine it further while remaining consistent with it. Annex D lists 12 elements that an industry guideline needs to define.

blocks.zh: D.2–D.12 需定義的 12 項要素
blocks.en: D.2–D.12 The 12 Elements to Be Defined

blocks.zh: D.10 跨產業標籤的 crossover 效應
blocks.en: D.10 Crossover Effects of Cross-Industry Labels

blocks.zh: 當供應商的出貨標籤從本產業流向域外客戶（例如 pharma CDMO 出貨給非 pharma 的零售通路），或域外供應商的標籤流入本產業時，雙方均應以 ISO 15394 本文規定的品質等級為基準。產業指引可設定更高要求，但不可低於本標準。
blocks.en: When a supplier's shipping label flows from this industry to a customer outside the domain (e.g., a pharma CDMO shipping to a non-pharma retail channel), or a label from a supplier outside the domain flows into this industry, both parties should use the quality levels specified in the body of ISO 15394 as the baseline. An industry guideline may set higher requirements but not lower than this standard.

blocks.zh: Pharma vs. Automotive AIAG — 應用指引差異比較
blocks.en: Pharma vs. Automotive AIAG — Comparison of Application Guidelines

blocks.zh: 比喻：應用指引 = 建築法規地方版
blocks.en: Analogy: application guideline = local version of the building code

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 = 國際建築基準法（最低標準）。各產業的 application guideline = 地方建築法規（在基準法之上加嚴）。Pharma 的 GS1 Healthcare 標籤規範就像「醫療建築特殊規定」，比一般建築要求更嚴格的防火、衛生標準。
blocks.en: ISO 15394 = the national building code (minimum standard). Each industry's application guideline = the local building regulations (stricter than the base code). The pharma GS1 Healthcare labeling specification is like "special medical building rules", with stricter fire protection and hygiene requirements than ordinary buildings.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：選擇 AI vs. DI 的判斷原則
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Principles for Choosing AI vs. DI

blocks.zh: 出貨給 pharma distributor / hospital：使用 GS1 AI（GS1-128 或 DataMatrix）
blocks.en: Shipping to a pharma distributor / hospital: use GS1 AI (GS1-128 or DataMatrix)

blocks.zh: 出貨給 automotive / industrial 客戶：可能需要 ANSI MH10.8.2 DI + Code 39/128
blocks.en: Shipping to an automotive / industrial customer: ANSI MH10.8.2 DI + Code 39/128 may be required

blocks.zh: 同一出貨箱供應多產業客戶：建議同時印製 GS1 + DI 條碼（見 Annex G）
blocks.en: One shipping carton serving customers from multiple industries: print both GS1 and DI bar codes (see Annex G)

blocks.zh: 客戶合約優先：當客戶合約指定符號學，優先遵循合約；ISO 15394 為底線
blocks.en: Customer contract first: when the customer contract specifies the symbology, follow the contract; ISO 15394 is the baseline

blocks.en: E.1.2 Pointers to a Database

blocks.en: DI (12K): SCAC carrier code

blocks.en: Figure E.10 (dual label) shows a shipping unit carrying both a carrier label (upper) and a supplier label (lower), containing the SSCC and GTIN + Lot respectively.

blocks.en: E.3 Modular Multi-Industry Transport Label

blocks.zh: 針對多方交接的複雜供應鏈，定義三個模組（Figure E.11–E.13）：

blocks.zh: 各類容器的建議貼標位置（Figure F.1–F.2）| p61–p63
blocks.en: Recommended Label Placement for Each Container Type (Figures F.1–F.2) | p61–p63

blocks.zh: Figure F.1 — 各容器貼標位置總覽
blocks.en: Figure F.1 — Overview of Label Placement by Container

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 Annex F 以圖示方式規定 12 種容器類型的標籤位置，以下整理為文字說明：
blocks.en: ISO 15394 Annex F specifies label positions for 12 container types in diagrams; they are summarized below in text.

blocks.zh: Figure F.2 — 承運人 vs. 客戶標籤位置
blocks.en: Figure F.2 — Carrier vs. Customer Label Positions

blocks.zh: 定義兩個標籤位置區：
blocks.en: Two label position zones are defined:

blocks.zh: Label 4A：Transportation MaxiCode 標籤（承運人用，置於包裝頂部或正面）
blocks.en: Label 4A: Transportation MaxiCode label (for the carrier, placed on the top or front of the package)

blocks.zh: Label 4B：Customer label（客戶用，置於包裝側面或正面）
blocks.en: Label 4B: Customer label (for the customer, placed on the side or front of the package)

blocks.zh: 使用者可選擇將兩者合併為單一標籤，同時滿足承運人與客戶需求。
blocks.en: Users may combine the two into a single label that meets both carrier and customer needs.

blocks.zh: Pharma 容器貼標重點解析
blocks.en: Key Points on Labelling Pharma Containers

blocks.zh: 棧板雙面貼標原則（Pallet — 最重要）
blocks.en: Two-Sided Pallet Labelling Principle (Pallet — Most Important)

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 要求棧板至少貼兩張標籤（Figure F.1b）。GS1 Healthcare 進一步建議：
blocks.en: ISO 15394 requires at least two labels on a pallet (Figure F.1b). GS1 Healthcare further recommends:

blocks.zh: 四面均貼標（360° 可讀）：適用於自動倉儲（ASRS）或高速輸送帶掃描
blocks.en: Labels on all four sides (readable through 360°): suitable for automated storage (ASRS) or high-speed conveyor scanning

blocks.zh: 至少兩個相鄰面（90° 夾角）：確保叉車從任何角度靠近均可掃到
blocks.en: At least two adjacent sides (at 90°): ensures a forklift approaching from any angle can scan the label

blocks.zh: 標籤底部距地板：400–800 mm（避開叉車叉齒干擾及地面污染）
blocks.en: Label bottom edge from the floor: 400–800 mm (avoids interference from forklift tines and floor contamination)

blocks.zh: 頂部距棧板頂面：≤ 100 mm（便於高位掃描槍讀取）
blocks.en: Top edge from the top of the pallet: ≤ 100 mm (for reading by a high-position scanner)

blocks.zh: 小容器（Vial / Syringe / Ampule）貼標挑戰
blocks.en: Labelling Challenges for Small Containers (Vial / Syringe / Ampule)

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 主要針對運輸單元（shipping unit）層級。對於 vial / syringe 等小型一次用容器，應參考 ISO 15223-1（醫療器材符號）、GS1 Healthcare Guideline for DataMatrix 及各市場 UDI 規範。
blocks.en: ISO 15394 mainly addresses the shipping unit level. For small single-use containers such as vials and syringes, refer to ISO 15223-1 (medical device symbols), the GS1 Healthcare Guideline for DataMatrix, and the UDI requirements of each market.

blocks.zh: 比喻：貼標位置 = 停車場出入口標誌
blocks.en: Analogy: label position = car park entrance sign

blocks.zh: 停車場的高度限制標誌必須在入口前夠遠的地方讓駕駛能看見，並且設在視線高度。條碼標籤的位置邏輯相同：放在掃描器可以「看到」的地方，不能被遮擋（shrink wrap / 標誌重疊），高度適合掃描器焦距。
blocks.en: A height-restriction sign in a car park must be placed far enough before the entrance for drivers to see it, and at eye level. Bar code label placement follows the same logic: put it where the scanner can "see" it, free of obstruction (shrink wrap / overlapping labels), at a height suited to the scanner's focal distance.

blocks.zh: CDMO 出貨貼標 SOP 重點
blocks.en: Key Points for a CDMO Shipping Labelling SOP

blocks.zh: 紙箱：右下角主標籤 + 至少 1 面側貼；收縮膜包裝前確認條碼讀取率
blocks.en: Cartons: main label at the lower right corner + at least 1 side label; confirm the bar code read rate before shrink wrapping

blocks.zh: 棧板：2 相鄰面各 1 張 SSCC 標籤；高度 400–600 mm
blocks.en: Pallets: 1 SSCC label on each of 2 adjacent sides; height 400–600 mm

blocks.zh: 冷鏈容器：標籤材質需耐 -80°C；考慮乾冰昇華時水氣冷凝對條碼的影響
blocks.en: Cold chain containers: label material must withstand -80°C; consider the effect of moisture condensation on the bar code when dry ice sublimates

blocks.zh: IPC 過程中：在線掃碼驗證（in-process check），使用認證掃描器，拒收率 < 0.1%
blocks.en: In-process control (IPC): in-line scan verification (in-process check) with a certified scanner; rejection rate < 0.1%

blocks.zh: 多重符號學環境：自動辨別、移轉策略與設備升級 | p64–p67
blocks.en: Multiple Symbology Environments: Auto-Discrimination, Migration Strategies and Equipment Upgrades | p64–p67

blocks.zh: G.1 概述 — 開放系統的多符號學問題
blocks.en: G.1 Overview — The Multiple Symbology Problem in Open Systems

blocks.zh: 開放供應鏈中，掃描器可能遇到三種組合（見 5.1.1）：
blocks.en: In an open supply chain, a scanner may encounter three combinations (see 5.1.1):

blocks.zh: 符號識別碼（Symbology Identifier，ISO/IEC 15424）是解碼器在資料前加入的前綴，不被編入條碼本身，由解碼器硬體自動附加輸出。
blocks.en: The Symbology Identifier (ISO/IEC 15424) is a prefix that the decoder adds before the data; it is not encoded in the bar code itself and is output automatically by the decoder hardware.

blocks.zh: G.2 單一選項環境
blocks.en: G.2 Single-Option Environment

blocks.zh: 僅掃描一種符號學時，主機系統應驗證符號識別碼，過濾掉不符合的資料流。Option (b) 用戶應關閉解碼器中其他符號學，防止誤讀。
blocks.en: When only one symbology is scanned, the host system should verify the symbology identifier and filter out non-conforming data streams. Users of option (b) should disable the other symbologies in the decoder to prevent misreads.

blocks.zh: G.3 多選項環境
blocks.en: G.3 Multiple-Option Environment

blocks.zh: 支援 2–3 種選項的系統必須完整實作符號識別碼能力（Symbology Identifier capability）。組合「符號識別碼 + DI 或 AI」可提供可靠的資料輸入，自動辨別各選項。
blocks.en: A system supporting 2–3 options must fully implement the Symbology Identifier capability. The combination of "symbology identifier + DI or AI" provides reliable data entry and automatic discrimination between the options.

blocks.zh: G.4 移轉路徑（Migration choices）
blocks.en: G.4 Migration Choices

blocks.zh: 可行的移轉路徑：
blocks.en: Feasible migration paths:

blocks.zh: 所有移轉都需要相當長的並行期（parallel operation period），並需供應商、承運人、客戶三方協議。
blocks.en: All migrations require a fairly long parallel operation period and agreement among the supplier, carrier and customer.

blocks.zh: G.4.3 設備需求
blocks.en: G.4.3 Equipment Requirements

blocks.zh: 印表機：需能正確產生新格式符號（含 FNC1 等控制字元）
blocks.en: Printers: must be able to correctly generate symbols in the new format (including control characters such as FNC1)

blocks.zh: 解碼器：設定為同時讀取新舊格式，並傳輸符號識別碼
blocks.en: Decoders: configured to read both old and new formats and to transmit the symbology identifier

blocks.zh: 不支援符號識別碼的老舊解碼器應升級或汰換
blocks.en: Older decoders that do not support symbology identifiers should be upgraded or replaced

blocks.zh: G.5 移轉管理建議
blocks.en: G.5 Migration Management Recommendations

blocks.zh: G.5.1 產業主管機構（如 GS1 Taiwan、AIAG）應先調查設備現況、規劃升級路徑、協調三方，並排定舊格式廢止期。
blocks.en: G.5.1 Industry authorities (such as GS1 Taiwan, AIAG) should first survey the current equipment, plan the upgrade path, coordinate the three parties, and set a phase-out date for the old format.

blocks.zh: G.5.2 標籤印製方應驗證映射軟體（AI/DI 格式差異，例如日期格式）、完整支援 FNC1，並在上線前進行印刷品質測試。
blocks.en: G.5.2 Label printers should verify the mapping software (AI/DI format differences, e.g., date format), fully support FNC1, and carry out print quality testing before go-live.

blocks.zh: G.5.3 標籤掃描方應確保解碼器符合 ISO/IEC 15424，實作 AI 與 DI 格式驗證軟體，並完成資料格式轉換邏輯（AI 格式與 DI 格式的日期、單位差異）。
blocks.en: G.5.3 Label scanners should ensure the decoders comply with ISO/IEC 15424, implement AI and DI format validation software, and complete the data format conversion logic (date and unit differences between AI and DI formats).

blocks.zh: 多重符號學 — CDMO 實戰解析
blocks.en: Multiple Symbologies — Practical Analysis for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 比喻：符號識別碼 = 語言標籤
blocks.en: Analogy: symbology identifier = language tag

blocks.zh: 想像條碼資料是電話語音留言，符號識別碼是系統自動在前面加上「這是中文留言」或「這是英文留言」的標記。主機系統（IT system）聽到「]C1」就知道是 GS1-128 的資料，用 AI 解析；聽到「]A0」就知道是 Code 39 + DI，用 DI 解析。沒有這個標記，系統就猜不出來該用哪套規則解讀。
blocks.en: Imagine the bar code data as a voice message, and the symbology identifier as a tag the system automatically adds at the front saying "this is a Chinese message" or "this is an English message". When the host system (IT system) hears "]C1" it knows the data is GS1-128 and parses it with AI; when it hears "]A0" it knows it is Code 39 + DI and parses it with DI. Without this tag, the system cannot tell which set of rules to use for interpretation.

blocks.zh: GS1 + 非 GS1 同標籤的設計原則
blocks.en: Design Principles for GS1 + Non-GS1 on the Same Label

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 同時供應 pharma 客戶（需要 GS1 AI）與 automotive 客戶（需要 DI）時，可在同一標籤上印製兩種條碼：
blocks.en: When a CDMO supplies both pharma customers (who need GS1 AI) and automotive customers (who need DI), two bar codes can be printed on the same label:

blocks.zh: 左側：GS1-128（含 GTIN + Lot + Exp，AI 格式）
blocks.en: Left side: GS1-128 (containing GTIN + Lot + Exp, AI format)

blocks.zh: 右側：Code 39（含 Part No. + Lot，DI 格式）
blocks.en: Right side: Code 39 (containing Part No. + Lot, DI format)

blocks.zh: 主機系統透過符號識別碼自動辨別，分別路由到對應的業務邏輯
blocks.en: The host system discriminates automatically through the symbology identifier and routes each to the corresponding business logic

blocks.zh: 兩者共享同一 Lot 資料，確保追溯一致性
blocks.en: Both share the same Lot data, ensuring consistent traceability

blocks.zh: 序列號格式建議（CDMO 自定義，AI 21）
blocks.en: Serial Number Format Recommendation (CDMO-defined, AI 21)

blocks.zh:
格式建議：[SiteCode][Year][JulianDate][Sequence]

範例：
  TW2026097001234
  ├─ TW    = 台灣廠區代碼
  ├─ 2026  = 年度
  ├─ 097   = 第 097 天（儒略曆）
  └─ 001234= 當日流水號（6碼，補零）

最大長度：20 個英數字元（X..20）
禁用字元：# % / 空格（GS1 規範）
唯一性：需在品牌持有人的 GTIN + 有效期範圍內唯一
blocks.en:
Recommended format: [SiteCode][Year][JulianDate][Sequence]

Example:
  TW2026097001234
  ├─ TW    = Taiwan site code
  ├─ 2026  = year
  ├─ 097   = day 097 (Julian date)
  └─ 001234= sequence number for the day (6 digits, zero-padded)

Maximum length: 20 alphanumeric characters (X..20)
Prohibited characters: # % / space (per GS1 rules)
Uniqueness: must be unique within the brand owner's GTIN + expiry range

blocks.zh: 5 道情境練習題，含詳解
blocks.en: 5 scenario-based practice questions with detailed answers

blocks.zh: Q1 — 積木式標籤的分段貼標
blocks.en: Q1 — Staged Labelling with Building Blocks

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 接受委託製造一款注射劑，產品批次識別（GTIN + Lot + Exp）在包裝時即可確認，但序列號（Serial Number）需等到客戶 MAH 在歐洲 EMVS 系統申請後才能分配。請問依 ISO 15394 積木式設計，應如何規劃此標籤的分段印製與貼標流程？需說明哪些積木應在哪個階段印製，以及 GMP 文件要求。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is contracted to manufacture an injectable product. The product batch identification (GTIN + Lot + Exp) can be confirmed at packaging, but the serial number cannot be assigned until the customer's MAH applies for it in the European EMVS system. Under the ISO 15394 building block design, how should the staged printing and labelling of this label be planned? Explain which blocks should be printed at which stage, and what the GMP documentation requirements are.

blocks.zh: 點擊查看詳解

blocks.zh: 階段一（包裝時）：印製並貼附「產品積木」—— 包含 AI 01（GTIN）、AI 10（Lot No.）、AI 17（Expiry Date）的 DataMatrix 條碼積木 + 人可讀文字積木。此積木不應被後續積木覆蓋（Packaging label module）。
blocks.en: Stage 1 (at packaging): print and apply the "product block" — a DataMatrix bar code block containing AI 01 (GTIN), AI 10 (Lot No.) and AI 17 (Expiry Date) + a human readable text block. This block must not be covered by later blocks (packaging label module).

blocks.zh: 階段二（MAH 分配序列號後）：印製「序列積木」—— 包含 AI 21（Serial Number），製作為獨立的標籤積木，貼覆於預留空白區或以 overlay 方式貼附。
blocks.en: Stage 2 (after the MAH assigns the serial number): print the "serial block" — containing AI 21 (Serial Number), made as a separate label block and applied over a reserved blank area or as an overlay.

blocks.zh: GMP 文件要求：BPR 中需記錄：(1) 各積木印製日期時間及操作員；(2) 序列號來源（由 MAH 通過哪個系統分配）；(3) 覆貼前的版面確認（包含照片記錄或電子驗證記錄）；(4) 廢棄標籤數量及銷毀記錄。符合 EU GMP Annex 16 及 FDA 21 CFR 211.68 要求。
blocks.en: GMP documentation requirements: the BPR must record: (1) the print date, time and operator for each block; (2) the source of the serial number (through which system the MAH assigned it); (3) layout confirmation before overlabelling (including photo records or electronic verification records); (4) the quantity of rejected labels and destruction records. This meets EU GMP Annex 16 and FDA 21 CFR 211.68.

blocks.zh: Q2 — 多重符號學環境的解碼器設定
blocks.en: Q2 — Decoder Settings in a Multiple Symbology Environment

blocks.zh: 您的倉儲同時收到三種出貨標籤：(1) 藥品供應商使用 GS1-128 + AI；(2) 化工原料供應商使用 Code 39 + DI "J"；(3) 醫療設備供應商使用 Code 128 + DI。WMS 系統在掃描條碼時經常將 (a) 和 (c) 混淆，導致資料解析錯誤。請依 Annex G 的建議，說明應如何設定解碼器及 WMS 軟體來解決此問題。
blocks.en: Your warehouse receives three types of shipping labels: (1) pharma suppliers use GS1-128 + AI; (2) chemical raw material suppliers use Code 39 + DI "J"; (3) medical device suppliers use Code 128 + DI. The WMS often confuses (a) and (c) when scanning bar codes, causing data parsing errors. Following the recommendations in Annex G, explain how to configure the decoders and the WMS software to solve this problem.

blocks.zh: 根源問題：GS1-128（option a）和 Code 128 + DI（option c）都使用 Code 128 物理符號，沒有符號識別碼就無法自動辨別。
blocks.en: Root problem: GS1-128 (option a) and Code 128 + DI (option c) both use the Code 128 physical symbol, and without a symbology identifier they cannot be distinguished automatically.

blocks.zh: 解碼器設定：確認解碼器支援 ISO/IEC 15424 Symbology Identifiers 輸出。GS1-128 輸出 ]C1，Code 128 + DI 輸出 ]C0，Code 39 + DI 輸出 ]A0。若解碼器不支援此功能，需升級韌體或汰換設備。
blocks.en: Decoder settings: confirm that the decoder supports ISO/IEC 15424 Symbology Identifier output. GS1-128 outputs ]C1, Code 128 + DI outputs ]C0, and Code 39 + DI outputs ]A0. If the decoder does not support this function, upgrade the firmware or replace the equipment.

blocks.zh: WMS 軟體：在掃描資料前端讀取符號識別碼（2–3 字元前綴），依 ]C1 / ]C0 / ]A0 路由至不同解析邏輯：
blocks.en: WMS software: read the symbology identifier (a 2–3 character prefix) at the front of the scanned data, and route to different parsing logic according to ]C1 / ]C0 / ]A0:

blocks.zh: ]C1 → GS1 AI 解析器（GTIN、Lot、Exp、Serial）
blocks.en: ]C1 → GS1 AI parser (GTIN, Lot, Exp, Serial)

blocks.zh: ]C0 → ANSI DI 解析器（Part No.、Lot、Qty）
blocks.en: ]C0 → ANSI DI parser (Part No., Lot, Qty)

blocks.zh: ]A0 → DI "J" 解析器（Licence Plate）
blocks.en: ]A0 → DI "J" parser (Licence Plate)

blocks.zh: Q3 — LPB 字高與條碼積木的設計衝突
blocks.en: Q3 — Conflict Between LPB Text Height and Bar Code Blocks

blocks.zh: 標籤設計師在設計一張 100 mm × 150 mm 的藥品外箱標籤時，客戶要求在同一標籤上印製：GTIN、Lot No.、Expiry Date（文字）、DataMatrix 條碼、GS1-128 條碼（SSCC），以及 Ship-from / Ship-to 地址。設計師希望在同一個積木中同時放置文字和 DataMatrix，但你注意到這不符合規範。請指出問題所在，並提出符合 ISO 15394 Annex C 的正確版面配置。
blocks.en: A label designer is designing a 100 mm × 150 mm pharmaceutical shipper carton label. The customer requires the following on the same label: GTIN, Lot No., Expiry Date (text), a DataMatrix bar code, a GS1-128 bar code (SSCC), and Ship-from / Ship-to addresses. The designer wants to place the text and the DataMatrix in the same block, but you notice this does not comply with the standard. Identify the problem and propose a correct layout consistent with ISO 15394 Annex C.

blocks.zh: 問題所在（Annex C.6.3）：文字積木（text building block）或文字子積木（text sub-block）不得包含條碼符號。DataMatrix 和文字必須分開置於不同積木。
blocks.en: The problem (Annex C.6.3): a text building block or text sub-block must not contain a bar code symbol. The DataMatrix and the text must be placed in separate blocks.

blocks.zh: 正確版面配置（由上而下）：
blocks.en: Correct layout (top to bottom):

blocks.zh: Carrier Segment（最上方）：雙高積木（51 mm）— GS1-128 SSCC 條碼 + HRI
blocks.en: Carrier Segment (top): double-height block (51 mm) — GS1-128 SSCC bar code + HRI

blocks.zh: Consignee Segment：標準積木（25 mm）— Ship-to 地址文字，2 個子積木（名稱 + 地址）
blocks.en: Consignee Segment: standard block (25 mm) — Ship-to address text, 2 sub-blocks (name + address)

blocks.zh: Shipper Segment：標準積木（25 mm）— Ship-from 地址文字
blocks.en: Shipper Segment: standard block (25 mm) — Ship-from address text

blocks.zh: Product Data 積木（條碼）：標準積木 — DataMatrix（含 GTIN + Lot + Exp + Serial）
blocks.en: Product Data block (bar code): standard block — DataMatrix (containing GTIN + Lot + Exp + Serial)

blocks.zh: Product Data 積木（文字）：標準積木 — GTIN / Lot / Exp 人可讀文字，各為獨立子積木，6 LPB 標題 + 3 LPB 資料
blocks.en: Product Data block (text): standard block — human readable text for GTIN / Lot / Exp, each in a separate sub-block, with 6 LPB titles + 3 LPB data

blocks.zh: Q4 — 冷鏈棧板標籤的材質與位置
blocks.en: Q4 — Material and Placement of Cold Chain Pallet Labels

blocks.zh: 您需要為一批 -80°C 超低溫凍乾原料藥（API）設計棧板運輸標籤，產品裝於乾冰冷凍容器（dry ice shipper）中，外層以透明塑膠膜包裹。標籤需在整個冷鏈運輸過程（-80°C 至到達現場 20°C 解凍前）保持可讀。請依 Annex F 及 GMP 實務，說明材質選擇、貼標位置及在線驗證要求。
blocks.en: You need to design pallet shipping labels for a batch of -80°C ultra-low temperature lyophilized active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), packed in dry ice shippers and wrapped in transparent plastic film. The label must remain readable throughout the cold chain transport (from -80°C until thawing on arrival at 20°C). Following Annex F and GMP practice, explain the material selection, label placement and in-process verification requirements.

blocks.zh: 材質選擇：標籤紙需使用「Cryogenic-grade」合成紙或聚酯薄膜（Polyester / Polypropylene），不得使用普通感熱紙（在低溫下黏著劑失效）。黏著劑需選用耐低溫壓克力膠（Acrylic cold-resistant adhesive），測試溫度至少達 -80°C。條碼印刷建議熱轉印（Thermal Transfer）或雷射印刷，而非感熱印刷（DT）。
blocks.en: Material selection: the label stock must be "cryogenic-grade" synthetic paper or film (polyester / polypropylene); ordinary direct thermal paper must not be used (the adhesive fails at low temperature). The adhesive must be a cold-resistant acrylic adhesive, tested to at least -80°C. Thermal transfer or laser printing is recommended for the bar code rather than direct thermal (DT) printing.

blocks.zh: 貼標位置（Annex F Figure F.1b）：棧板兩個相鄰面各貼一張標籤（4A + 4B 位置）。標籤位置：底部距地面 400–800 mm，避開乾冰昇華區（底部 100 mm 內）。透明塑膠膜包裹後，確認條碼在膜外仍可被直接掃描（不被水氣或冷凝遮蔽）。若外膜阻礙掃描，考慮在標籤外側加覆透明保護貼或使用標籤貼 pocket。
blocks.en: Label placement (Annex F Figure F.1b): one label on each of two adjacent sides of the pallet (positions 4A + 4B). Label position: bottom edge 400–800 mm from the floor, avoiding the dry ice sublimation zone (within 100 mm of the bottom). After wrapping with transparent plastic film, confirm that the bar code can still be scanned directly through the film (not obscured by moisture or condensation). If the outer film obstructs scanning, consider adding a transparent protective cover over the label or using a label pocket.

blocks.zh: 在線驗證：低溫環境掃描驗證應於包裝完成後、冷凍存放前執行，確認條碼讀取率 ≥ 99.9%（使用認證 ISO 驗證器）。另在解凍後（收貨方驗收時）再次掃描，確認冷鏈過程未損壞條碼。兩次掃描結果均記錄於 BPR。
blocks.en: In-process verification: scan verification in the low temperature environment should be performed after packing is complete and before frozen storage, confirming a bar code read rate ≥ 99.9% (using a certified ISO verifier). Scan again after thawing (at receiving inspection by the consignee) to confirm the cold chain process has not damaged the bar code. Both scan results are recorded in the BPR.

blocks.zh: Q5 — 全球多市場出貨的「一標通用」設計
blocks.en: Q5 — A "Universal Label" Design for Global Multi-Market Shipments

blocks.zh: 貴公司 CDMO 客戶（MAH）計畫將同一批次藥品同時出口至美國（DSCSA）、歐盟（EU FMD）及中國（NMPA 追溯碼）。請說明在 ISO 15394 + GS1 框架下，如何設計一張能滿足三個市場要求的標籤，並指出哪些元素是通用的、哪些是市場特定的，以及如何在實務上處理「中國 20 位追溯碼」與 GS1 AI 並存的問題。
blocks.en: Your CDMO's customer (the MAH) plans to export the same batch of drug product to the US (DSCSA), the EU (EU FMD) and China (NMPA traceability code) at the same time. Under the ISO 15394 + GS1 framework, explain how to design one label that meets the requirements of all three markets, identify which elements are common and which are market specific, and how to handle in practice the coexistence of the "China 20-digit traceability code" and GS1 AIs.

blocks.zh: 通用元素（三市場共同）：
blocks.en: Common elements (shared by all three markets):

blocks.zh: DataMatrix 含 AI 01（GTIN）+ AI 10（Lot）+ AI 17（Exp）+ AI 21（Serial）— 滿足 DSCSA 和 EU FMD 四要素，也是中國追溯碼的數據來源
blocks.en: DataMatrix with AI 01 (GTIN) + AI 10 (Lot) + AI 17 (Exp) + AI 21 (Serial) — meets the DSCSA and EU FMD four elements, and is also the data source for the China traceability code

blocks.zh: GS1-128（SSCC）— 棧板 / 外箱追溯
blocks.en: GS1-128 (SSCC) — pallet / shipper carton traceability

blocks.zh: 人可讀文字：Product Name、Lot No.、Exp Date（通用）
blocks.en: Human readable text: Product Name, Lot No., Exp Date (common)

blocks.zh: 市場特定元素：
blocks.en: Market-specific elements:

blocks.zh: EU FMD：NCC（National Code Container）= 防偽封口完整性標記，需實體標籤
blocks.en: EU FMD: NCC (National Code Container) = anti-tampering device integrity marker, requires a physical label

blocks.zh: 中國：NMPA 20 位追溯碼，需另加一個 DataMatrix 條碼（或 QR Code），使用 AI 91 或 AI 240 編碼中國追溯碼，或將 NMPA 碼印於額外積木
blocks.en: China: the NMPA 20-digit traceability code requires an additional DataMatrix bar code (or QR Code), encoding the China traceability code with AI 91 or AI 240, or printing the NMPA code in an additional block

blocks.zh: 各市場語言 HRI：英文（美 / 歐）、中文（中國）
blocks.en: HRI language for each market: English (US / EU), Chinese (China)

blocks.zh: 實務解決方案：在標籤上印製兩個 DataMatrix：(1) GS1 DataMatrix（含 4 個標準 AI）；(2) 中國 NMPA DataMatrix（AI 91 + 20 位碼）。使用 ISO 15394 的積木設計，將 NMPA 積木置於 GS1 積木旁側或下方，標注「CN Traceability Code」標題。電子追溯部分：GS1 EPCIS 上傳至 EMVS（EU）及 VRS（US）；NMPA 平台另行上傳中文格式資料。
blocks.en: Practical solution: print two DataMatrix codes on the label: (1) a GS1 DataMatrix (with the 4 standard AIs); (2) a China NMPA DataMatrix (AI 91 + 20-digit code). Using the ISO 15394 building block design, place the NMPA block beside or below the GS1 block, with the heading "CN Traceability Code". For electronic traceability: GS1 EPCIS uploads to EMVS (EU) and VRS (US); the NMPA platform receives separately uploaded data in the Chinese format.
